Package org.apache.juneau.console

Class Topics

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.console.Topics
public final class Topics extends Object
Builds framework topic names so callers do not hand-format "family:key" strings.
Example:

Topics.selection("changes"); // "selection:changes" Topics.cmd("tasks"); // "cmd:tasks" Topics.job(ref.id()); // "job:j-91"

Since:
10.0.0

      public static String custom(String ns, String name)
      Parameters:
      ns - The namespace, for example ssc.
      name - The name within it, for example focus.
      Returns:
      ns.name.

    • custom

      public static String custom(String ns, String name, String key)
      Parameters:
      ns - The namespace.
      name - The name within it.
      key - The key, or * for a declaration pattern.
      Returns:
      ns.name:key.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - E-45 / E-40 as for custom(String, String), or E-40 on a bad key.
